## Historical audit: S0282

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_v3/results/historical_r1_C2_start/test/bw_0023/2/trajectory.jsonl`. References below identify JSONL lines and the supplied observation’s character range.

| Evidence | Observation and interpretation |
|---|---|
| H `model_request`, line 1 [0,11520) | The requested task was to reconstruct a 512 × 288 indoor reference photograph with separate SceneAct/Blender meshes, matching geometry, materials, camera and framing. The prompt requested a complete first build, rendered comparison and correction. This is the intended goal, not evidence that the scene was built. The image itself is not visible in this audit. |
| H `codex_session`, line 2 [0,4955) | A fresh read-only CLI session was launched with the image supplied. It timed out after approximately 900 seconds. The record reports zero observed tool calls and file changes, but the backend request count and actual model are unknown. No autonomous exploration is visible. |
| H `model_error`, line 3 [0,2102); `scene_error`, line 4 [0,2893) | The timeout propagated through `runtime.ask` as a scene error. No returned program, Blender execution, rendered image, revision or validation appears in the supplied trajectory. This is a **technical interruption**, not evidence of an algorithmic reconstruction failure, a formally incorrect scene, or an empty patch. Completion and any downstream outcome are unknown. |

**Scene checks:** There is no visible reconstruction to assess for multiple objects, materials or textures, part connections, pose, camera, lighting or render defects. The reference image path is recorded, but its contents cannot be inferred from the path. Neither geometry nor visual correctness was independently verified.

**Teacher and lessons:** No teacher detection, diagnosis, proposed update, input or adoption is visible; the system instructions in the request are not evidence of teacher feedback. A transferable lesson is to distinguish a model-call timeout from a Blender/render bottleneck and from visual defects. The task-specific unresolved question is what the reference contained and whether any reconstruction would have matched it. The cause of the CLI timeout and any unobserved internal model activity remain unknown.
